image_description: A small, slender snake coiled in a tight loop on a textured, light blue-grey surface. The snake has a distinct two-tone coloration: the dorsal side is dark brown/black and glossy, while the ventral side (visible where the body twists) is pale pinkish-white. The head is small and blunt, blending into the body. The image has a shallow depth of field with significant blur in the background.
